title: 2.15 See You at the Park!
unit_outcome: Say where and how people go, what people have and what things are, compare people and things, and understand classroom commands in Spanish.
goal: Spend a day at the park with Ana's friends, then answer them out loud.
grammar_function: All Spanish A1+ Unit 2 patterns, in a mission.
prerequisite: Spanish A1 Unit 2 and A1+ Unit 1 and A1+ 2.1-2.14.
speaking_outcome: Spend a day at the park with Ana's friends, then answer them out loud.

cards.audio_text: Él va en bicicleta. Ella camina. Ella va en carro. Él va en autobús.
cards.spanish_translation: He goes by bike. She walks. She goes by car. He goes by bus.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 01/10: Ana's friends arrive at the park; the learner hears how one person comes and discovers how the game responds, then finds the other three (2.1-2.2: by bike, walks, by car, by bus).

audio_assets.text: Ana meets her friends at the park. Listen to each sentence and find who or what it describes. At the end, answer her friends' questions out loud for Ana. First we will practice together.

cards.audio_text: Ella tiene una cámara. Él tiene audífonos. Ella no tiene una cámara. Ella tiene un reloj. Él tiene una cartera.
cards.spanish_translation: She has a camera. He has headphones. She doesn't have a camera. She has a watch. He has a wallet.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 02/10: four friends sit on a picnic blanket, each with one thing (2.3: has); the camera woman also wears a watch, so the watch clue first says she doesn't have a camera.
